description: Rally Cross (989 Studios, 1997), recompiled for the TrimUI Brick.
features: 60 frames a second in a one-player race, all of it the game, at its true speed.
Resolution: 320 x 240, 640 x 480 or 1024 x 768, set in Options.
Medium High: a higher camera between Medium and Far.
HUD: turn each part of it off, in the pause menu.
Shadows: each car's own shape cast along the sun onto the ground.
Conditions: a season, a time of day and the weather, in the game's own menus.
The Lost Mines' tunnel: its flames flicker orange on the rock and the cars.
A native renderer: a race's frame takes no PlayStation packets.
Controls: every button can be remapped, set in Options.
changelog: Same pace as the emulator: 59.85 Hz.
Sound is never stretched, and no longer tied to the frame rate.
CD music reads ahead, so it can't run out.
